name: claude-code
description: Claude Code MCP integration for external AI agent collaboration. Enables brainstorming, plan validation, and code review with Claude as a second-opinion agent.

interface.longDescription: Lets Codex consult Claude Code for brainstorming, plan validation, and code review. Claude runs as the operator's own Claude Code (their configuration, plugins, and MCP servers) in read-only mode by default, with an opt-in writable mode. Includes the collaborating-with-claude skill with collaboration guidelines.
